A celebration isn't a celebration until this fruit-filled crust hits the table!|Recipe Book|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Fruit Pies are made by [[Cooking]] [[Tabantha Wheat]], [[Cane Sugar]], [[Goat Butter]], and any [[Fruit]] together in a [[Cooking Pot]]. However, [[Apple]]s are unable to be used in this [[Recipe]], as the resulting dish will be [[Apple Pie]]. Regular Fruit Pie can be made by using either [[Palm Fruit]]s or [[Wildberry|Wildberries]]. Eating these Pies will restore some of [[Link]]'s [[Heart]]s to his [[Life Gauge]]. Fruit Pies are used commonly in celebrations in [[Hyrule]]. Different variations of Fruit Pie can be made by using specific Fruits or by adding additional [[Ingredient]]s. These variations are: * '''Chilly Fruit Pie''':{{Cite|{{Big|Chilly Fruit Pie}}
Grants low-level heat resistance.
A celebration isn't a celebration until this fruit-filled crust hits the table!|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Hydromelon]]s or other chilly Ingredients. Eating them will increase Link's [[Heat Resistance]] by one level. * '''Electro Fruit Pie''':{{Cite|{{Big|Electro Fruit Pie}}
Grants low-level electricity resistance.
A celebration isn't a celebration until this fruit-filled crust hits the table!|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Voltfruit]]s or other electric Ingredients. If consumed, they grant Link one temporary level of [[Shock Resistance]]. * '''Enduring Fruit Pie''':{{Cite|{{Big|Enduring Fruit Pie}}
Restores and overfills your Stamina Wheel.
A celebration isn't a celebration until this fruit-filled crust hits the table!|Inventory|BotW}} Made using enduring Ingredients. If eaten, they will completely refill and overfill Link's [[Stamina Wheel]]. * '''Energizing Fruit Pie''':{{Cite|{{Big|Energizing Fruit Pie}}
Instantly refills some of your Stamina Wheel.
A celebration isn't a celebration until this fruit-filled crust hits the table!|Inventory|BotW}} Made using energizing Ingredients. Eating these will refill a portion of Link's Stamina Wheel. * '''Hasty Fruit Pie''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hasty Fruit Pie}}
Grants a low-level movement-speed boost.
A celebration isn't a celebration until this fruit-filled crust hits the table!|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Fleet-Lotus Seeds]] or other hasty Ingredients. Consuming these pies will temporarily boost Link's movement speed. * '''Hearty Fruit Pie''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hearty Fruit Pie}}
Restores your health and temporarily increases your maximum hearts.
A celebration isn't a celebration until this fruit-filled crust hits the table!|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Hearty Durian]]s or other hearty Ingredients. When eaten, these Pies will completely heal all of Link's Hearts and temporarily increase his maximum Hearts. * '''Mighty Fruit Pie''':{{Cite|{{Big|Mighty Fruit Pie}}
Grants a low-level attack-power boost.
A celebration isn't a celebration until this fruit-filled crust hits the table!|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Mighty Bananas]] or other mighty Ingredients. These pies temporarily increase Link's attack power when he eats them. * '''Sneaky Fruit Pie''':{{Cite|{{Big|Sneaky Fruit Pie}}
Grants a low-level stealth boost.
A celebration isn't a celebration until this fruit-filled crust hits the table!|Inventory|BotW}} Made using sneaky Ingredients. When eaten, they'll increase Link's [[Stealth]] temporarily. * '''Spicy Fruit Pie''':{{Cite|{{Big|Spicy Fruit Pie}}
Grants low-level cold resistance.
A celebration isn't a celebration until this fruit-filled crust hits the table!|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Spicy Pepper]]s or other spicy Ingredients. They grant Link one level of [[Cold Resistance]] if they're eaten. * '''Tough Fruit Pie''':{{Cite|{{Big|Tough Fruit Pie}}
Grants a low-level defense boost.
A celebration isn't a celebration until this fruit-filled crust hits the table!|Inventory|BotW}} Made using tough Ingredients.
